Chief_Complaint.source_text: CC: Diarrhea and vomiting for 3 days
CC: Diarrhea and vomiting for 3 days

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Diarrhea started as watery and is now very loose
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Diarrhea started as watery, now very loose

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Diarrhea has occurred approximately 4 times today
Patient feels feverish and describes feeling "literally boiling"
Patient is vomiting everything including liquids
Last vomiting episode was about 2 hours ago after breakfast
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Last vomited ~2 hours ago after breakfast

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Abdominal pain around the navel that comes and goes with the urge to defecate
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Abdominal pain around navel, comes and goes with urge to defecate

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Possible infectious gastroenteritis considered due to symptomatic contact
Patient tried oral rehydration solution three times per day for two days without improvement
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Tried ORS 3x/day for 2 days without improvement

Medications.content: Uses ibuprofen occasionally for menstrual cramps

Family_History.content: Brother currently has similar gastrointestinal symptoms

Social_and_Family_History.content: Lives with her brother and mother
Social_and_Family_History.source_text: FH: Lives with brother and mother

Assessment.content: Gastroenteritis is thought to be likely viral
Bacterial gastroenteritis is considered possible due to contact with symptomatic brother
Assessment.source_text: possible bacterial due to contact with symptomatic brother

Assessment.content: At risk of dehydration due to vomiting and diarrhea
Assessment.source_text: Dehydration risk due to vomiting and diarrhea

Plan_of_Care.content: Arrange urgent clinic appointment for stool sample and hydration assessment
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Urgent clinic appointment for stool sample and hydration assessment

Plan_of_Care.content: Continue oral rehydration solution in small sips
Follow a simple diet including toast and biscuits
Monitor symptoms and seek urgent care if symptoms worsen
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Monitor symptoms; seek urgent care if worsens

Follow_up_Information.content: Patient to attend an urgent clinic appointment
